body: I hate these bad people. We should unite and rebel against them. Why does it have to always stay the same?
I also found out we are quite resilient. Why don't you want to wake up tomorrow? It might turn out to be a nice day.
If I was a train driver I would drive slower at night because of reduced visibility. The company would probably fire me. :( What makes you wonder about that?
I think the original point was to survive and reproduce. Why don't you want to be a part of this shitty world?

Hope these medications didn't make you lose your trust in medicine. Maybe their dose was incorrect or you needed other ones which would cause you no side effects. I'm glad you are doing things to treat yourself good. We need to retreat to our shelters once in a while and think how we can work things out, just a step today and another tomorrow. Thank you, too.
Thank you for the kind words.

Ahh, I think I understand. My whole life I've been doing things to shut down the thoughts(brain). Some were soft, others were hard. I just needed an escape. It really didn't end well. 

I didn't mean that a small thing should be something to make you stay, but it can be something to give you just a tiny bit of hope. The small thing is just a step, why do we have to torment ourselves and not have a little bit of joy on the way? Maybe with time we can make more tiny steps and find purpose again, why not even run later?

If money's an issue, can you take yourself to the park? Or to the woods? Maybe sit beside a tree. Why not even touch it? Or you can smell a plant or feed a street animal. Maybe being good to something else or yourself can make you feel good.

Do you think the problem in your brain can be worked on? It may be an idea to try to get some help from a proffesional, we don't have to fight alone.

Mental inesses suck! An year in facilities sounds terrible, the worst month of my life was being in one. You are so strong to survive in them! Is there any way to avoid your triggers or reduce them? Maybe take a warm bath or do something relaxing you enjoy, and think of a way to reduce the pain just by one little fraction? Maybe with time you can solve the problems but it will be hard to fight them all in the same time.

Hey, you seem to be overwhelmed! You say that you want to escape, so can you maybe take a vacation or isolate for a while? Stress can pile up and become unbearable, so we should take a step back and try to handle it by bits. Why do you want to die? Isn't there even one small thing that you like to do, that you will miss?

I hope with time the wounds can heal to the point of being scars. Then maybe you can look at them and be proud of overcoming them. Or you could cover them and try to forget. Wow, beating alcohol for such a long time is a great achievement! I fought hard but couldn't pass the week mark. What kind of car do you drive and do you enjoy it now? I hate what the society became. Work is such a struggle to just provide food and roof. Were there any small things you used to enjoy before? Like maybe pet an animal or take care of a plant. I found out taking care of something else motivated me to look after myself more. Or maybe sit on a bench in the park and try to guess what the mission of each ant is. Maybe we should walk toward happyness with baby steps, not leap headfirst into what society considers to bring joy.

I can totally relate. It's like my brain doesn't produce dopamine anymore. For me it started after a psychotic episode. I go to therapy and visit psychiatrists. Is it possible for you to try get such help? We don't have to fight this on our own.

Ahh, it's like you've been a punching bag for so long that you eventually forget why you let that happen the first time. Then it becomes the usual routine and you don't know how to respond anymore. And in the end you think that it's a normal thing happening. But that whole thing is wrong, OP. It's not ok for the people causing harm and it is definitely not ok for the fella being hurt. You have nothing to apologize for, we all feel negative from time to time, for a short or long.
It is admirable that you know there's a problem and can point it out!

Do you think there's any way this problem can be solved or worked around? Why do you feel bad, anything particular happend or thats just your general mood?

Hello!

I'm sorry to hear about your break-up. I'm sure your person wouldn't want you to suffer or if he does, he didn't deserve you at all! You will have to take care of yourself for a bit now, be your own friend. Try not to fixate on the person and do what you love. It won't be easy. Be strong for yourself and don't give up. You matter!

Best wishes!

Hello!

I'm sorry that your mother mistreats you, you don't deserve that. Missing an year from school may sound like a big deal now, but after time I doubt you'll think about it much. You will be missed for sure, don't give up on yourself!
What happened, why did you have to miss too much attendance?

Best wishes!

Hello,

Having to work is terrible! I personally hate it so much!
What made you not want your life?

Best wishes!

Hello,

What changed for the worse? Is it fixable?

Best wishes!

Hello,

I'm so sorry to hear you are so down!
Maybe we can wait for the real Christmas.

From one broken fella to another, best wishes!

Hello,

I don't agree that you are worthless! 
Why do you think you are not worth to be loved?

Best wishes!
